provenance: PR #60 R11: round 1's non-string guard lived inside `_whole_string`, and its comment claimed that was "the one place both tiers route through". It is not — the role tier's EXACT pass builds `get_by_role(role, name=name, exact=True)` before the folded pass is ever constructed, so Playwright's own escaping raised `AttributeError: 'float' object has no attribute 'replace'` first and `classify` labelled the step `act`. `name` is the most-used target key in the repo and the one the shipped case did not cover. The guard now runs at the top of `resolve()`, before ANY locator is built, over every string-valued key.

triage.note: `invariant` rather than `fast` because it is a must-always-hold property of diagnosis (INV-1) and because the `fast` band's real margin at this case count is 0.64s (PR #60 R13) — the family of three costs ~0.3s and `invariant` has the room. `resolver-non-string-target-is-a-locate-failure` stays in `fast` as the representative.
